title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Learning agent for personalised microlearning and learning paths
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, deployment paths, Graph operations and licensing statements are supported. It appropriately reports the disagreement between the launched roadmap status and the overview's preview wording. The Frontier visibility statement needs a minor qualification from Microsoft's newer guidance.
